reviews.text: I love Svetlana and Brani! They always make me feel my best and I love my hair every time.

Avery & Eric are awesome!! Today was my first time coming to this salon & I got a balayage & cut/blowout. They both exceeded my expectations. I’m not usually one to leave reviews but I had such a great experience I felt I needed to share. Highly recommend!
I love the team at Montana Salon! Macy always does an incredible job with my color and helps me achieve my hair goals with each season ❤️ & thank you to Patrick for the fantastic cut & blowout today!
